name: @videoblitzer/desktop-recorder
description: Production desktop recorder for VideoBlitzer uploads and local capture workflows.
author: VideoBlitzer

scripts.build: tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/build-screen-helper.mjs && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --arm64 --config electron-builder.mac.json
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.json
